item.title: Review: The Masterstroke Storytelling of The Mastermind
item.description: She’s notoriously private, so we can only assume that Kelly Reichardt’s work reflects her own persona: highly-skilled and visually stunning, quietly revealing human stories. Most of Reichardt’s work has an earthy, grounded quality, with an ecological message that’s never forced upon the viewer. item.title: War Machine – Alan Ritchson goes up against an otherworldly killing machine in the new action sci-fi film
item.description: Directed by Patrick Hughes, the film stars Alan Ritchson, Dennis Quaid, Stephan James, Jai Courtney, Esai Morales, Keiynan Lonsdale, and Daniel Webber. During the final stage of U.S. Army Ranger selection, an elite team’s training exercise turns into a fight for survival against an unimaginable threat. War Machine hits Netflix on 6th March.
